output:
I'll start by looking at the docs and the package layout.

That call was malformed and didn't run. I'll start applying the fixes, beginning with the calendar and periods code.

I'll use the edit tool instead, one file at a time.

The `cycles.py` edit failed with EBUSY. I'll check its current state and retry.

That call was cut off and didn't run. I'll use `write_file` for the rewrites.

Parallel edits to the same file hit EBUSY. I'll check which edits landed in `lines.py` and `compute.py`.

Only the import and the `qty` edit failed or landed oddly in `lines.py`. I'll redo the other edits one at a time.

Now make `requests_for` tolerant of broken files and make each request apply atomically.

Another shell call got cut off. I'll make these small fixes with `edit_file`, sequentially.

I fixed the bugs in `/app/billing`, and all 82 unit tests now pass. I ran `python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` from `/app` and it reported `OK`. `tools/reconcile.py` reports no disagreements. `python -m billing run --out /tmp/out` built every document except 8 credit requests, which were refused for crediting more units than were invoiced. The docs say those are errors. I didn't re-derive any document by hand beyond what the tests and the reconcile script check.

The fixes, all done to follow the docs:

- **Periods and proration:**
  - February now has 29 days in leap years.
  - Each period start is computed from the anchor alone, so a month-end clamp no longer shifts later periods.
  - Used days count both the first and last day.
- **Catalog tiers:**
  - Tiers are compared by their numeric minimum, so string and number minimums mix correctly.
  - Selection picks the largest minimum that doesn't exceed the quantity.
  - Unit prices and minimums must be proper strings or whole numbers.
- **Discounts:**
  - Amount discounts convert with the order currency's exponent instead of always 2.
  - Order discounts apply percentages first, then amounts.
  - Order-discount shares use the largest remainder method, with ties going to the earlier line and at most one extra unit per line.
- **Rounding:** Gross amounts, percentage steps and tax use exact fractions, with ties rounded away from zero.
- **Tax:** Under `invoice` rounding, a group's tax is now rounded once from the exact line taxes instead of from already-rounded ones.
- **Credit notes:**
  - A failed request no longer leaves partial credited totals behind for later requests.
  - Credit notes take each line's tax percent from the invoice line.
  - A credit file that can't be read is skipped rather than blocking other requests.
  - Credit quantities must be whole numbers.
- **Input checks:** Dates, document numbers, tax percents and subscription period numbers are checked strictly.
- **`run` command:** `run` also keeps going if one document fails unexpectedly.

I wrote `/app/STATUS.json` with status `success`. I didn't touch `/app/tests`, `/app/data` or `/app/docs`.

command_result.command: cd /app && find . -type f -not -path './.git/*' | head -100 && cat docs/overview.md && wc -l billing/*.py docs/*
cd /app && cat docs/money.md docs/catalog.md docs/subscriptions.md docs/discounts.md
cd /app && cat docs/tax.md docs/credit-notes.md docs/output.md docs/changelog.md; ls docs/archive tools; ls data | head; git status 2>&1 | head -3
cd /app && head -30 docs/subscriptions.md; cd billing; for f in errors.py data.py cli.py money/*.py catalog/*.py periods/*.py; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done
cd /app/billing/money; for f in currency.py convert.py rounding.py format.py; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done
cd /app/billing; for f in pricing/*.py subscriptions/*.py; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done
cd /app/billing; for f in tax/*.py invoices/*.py credits/*.py; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done
cd /app/billing; tail -n +95 tax/rates.py; for f in invoices/*.py; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done
cd /app/billing; tail -n 20 tax/rates.py; cat credits/*.py; cat ../tools/reconcile.py | head -60
cd /app && ls tests; grep -n "price_to_minor\|percent(\|to_minor\|allocate\|round_minor\|tax_part\|parse_amount" -r tests/*.py | head -40; python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -30
cd /app/billing && cat pricing/lines.py | sed -n 1,40p; grep -n "Fraction\|exact" tax/compute.py

cd /app/billing && sed -i 's/if spec.get("active_from") else None/if spec.get("active_from") is not None else None/; s/if spec.get("active_to") else None/if spec.get("active_to") is not None else None/' subscriptions/proration.py && grep -n active_ subscriptions/proration.py

cd /app/billing && sed -i 's/        except BillingError as e:/        except (BillingError, KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, AttributeError, ArithmeticError, UnicodeDecodeError) as e:/; s/    except BillingError as e:/    except (BillingError, KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, AttributeError, ArithmeticError, UnicodeDecodeError) as e:/' cli.py && grep -n except cli.py; cd .. && python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -40

cd /app/billing && sed -i 's/_ORDER.match(/_ORDER.fullmatch(/; s/_INVOICE.match(/_INVOICE.fullmatch(/' invoices/numbering.py && sed -i 's/RateRow(r\["category"\], parse_date(r\["from"\]), str(r\["percent"\]))/RateRow(r["category"], parse_date(r["from"]), _percent_text(r["percent"]))/' tax/rates.py && grep -n "fullmatch\|_percent_text" invoices/numbering.py tax/rates.py
cd /app && python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -5; python tools/reconcile.py 2>&1 | tail -20; python -m billing run --out /tmp/out | tail -3; cat /tmp/out/errors.json | head -30
